svg.title: Forward-written FWM matrix multiplier with two circulating frequency bands
svg.desc: Proposed functional optical layout for the 32 by 32 displacement-encoded matrix. Panel A traces the read loop. A query enters the high half of a 64-tooth data packet with the low answer half dark. The same guide receives a fixed reference pump and a weight packet with a fixed central tone. A pass rejects pumps, restores idler gain and routes the two halves through a diplexer and two clocked bar/cross switches. The query crosses a sign-selectable single-sideband shifter. The coherent answer crosses a matched bypass. A second diplexer reassembles the bands. The band edge filter rejects overflow. After 32 visits the low band contains Wq. The lower panel shows separate write slots in the very same guide. A held residual, two signed key tones and the reference mix. The selected increment is coherently injected into the corresponding packet of a recirculating fiber memory. A gated weight tap supplies the read pump mux. Source and carrier selection at the shared guide are shown by separate read and write views. Path lengths and device efficiencies are unspecified.
